items.name: bounds-inspection-tool
items.title: Bounds Inspection Tool
items.description: Headless measurement readout: the selected body's axis-aligned bounds from the settled scene's kernel measurement, with the kernel's declared tightness and honest null semantics.

items.name: distance-inspection-tool
items.title: Distance Inspection Tool
items.description: Headless measurement readout: the distance between the selection's references, distinguishing 'not requested' from 'declined' with the domain's structured refusal codes.

items.name: mass-properties-inspection-tool
items.title: Mass Properties Inspection Tool
items.description: Headless measurement readout: volume, area, and centroid of the selected body from the settled scene's kernel measurements.

items.name: radius-inspection-tool
items.title: Radius Inspection Tool
items.description: Headless measurement readout: the cylindrical face radius under the selection — a selected face that fits no cylinder reports nothing rather than a wrong number.

items.name: datum-tool
items.title: Datum Tool
items.description: Headless session datum resolution: resolves a document's datum records (planes, axes, points) to sketch workplanes and feature placements the feature executors consume.

items.name: extrude-tool
items.title: Extrude Tool
items.description: Headless feature executor: turns a document's extrude feature (sketch profile, height, direction) into the kernel scene request the solid build consumes.

items.name: revolve-tool
items.title: Revolve Tool
items.description: Headless feature executor: turns a document's revolve feature (sketch profile, axis, angle) into the kernel scene request the solid build consumes.

items.name: hole-tool
items.title: Hole Tool
items.description: Headless feature executor: turns a document's hole feature (diameter, depth, placement on the extruded base) into the boolean cut the solid build consumes.
